text: This informational website does not provide a form for collecting patient or referral information. Article search and printable resources do not submit search terms or worksheet responses to the practice.

New-patient scheduling opens SimplePractice, a separate service. Information entered there is handled by that service and the practice’s approved policies. The existing-patient portal opens the separately verified SimplePractice sign-in page. The secure referral destination is awaiting verification. Call the practice for assistance; do not send clinical records through this public website.

The hosting provider may process technical request information such as IP addresses and browser details. Hosting logs, retention, third-party arrangements, and the practice’s patient privacy notices require confirmation before launch. This draft does not replace the practice’s approved Notice of Privacy Practices.
